limitations: Risk classification is not causal outcome proof or privacy verification.
Fixed noise_multiplier can override target_epsilon, as the pinned PrivacyArgs explicitly documents.
max_steps can set actual training stop, but native PrivacyEngine still receives fractional num_train_epochs for calibration.
training.params.num_train_epochs has no binding; declaration plus captured source constant must not be described as bindings_observed.
Raw config max_grad_norm is explicitly mapped to PrivacyArgs.max_grad_norm_dp and PrivacyEngine.max_grad_norm; field names are not automatically interchangeable.
No recursive wildcard or blanket params promotion; user profiles retain original first-match and exact-key child override semantics; broader earlier patterns can still win.
Keep all historical reports byte-identical; any future changed-field gold is a separately reviewed supplement.
